name: root-cause
question: The input has three sections. [BUG] describes a bug that was planted in an app: the symptom, the true cause, and the files where the cause lives. [TICKET_GOALS] is the goal of each ticket the Project Manager wrote from the problem that bug caused. [EVIDENCE_FILES] is the file paths attached as evidence to those tickets. Decide whether the ticket goals name the cause. Verdicts: root_cause = a goal names the true cause and points at where to fix it; symptom_only = the goals only restate the symptom without the cause; wrong = the goals name a different cause or point somewhere unrelated; cannot_tell = the input does not let you decide. The quote must be the part of the input that decided your verdict (the goal words that name the cause, or for symptom_only and wrong the goal that shows it).
